name: rewind-bowl
description: Rewind Bowl — a retro VHS football game for mobile

scripts.test: tsx src/game/sim.test.ts && tsx src/game/season.test.ts && tsx src/game/traits.test.ts && npm run test:ui && node --test tools/play-publish.test.mjs tools/play-publish.http.test.mjs tools/play-promote.http.test.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && cap sync && npm run release:record
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap run android
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap run ios
scripts.mobile:logs: adb logcat -v time chromium:V Capacitor/Console:V Capacitor:V '*:S'
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node scripts/release-record.mjs --artifact android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk --label 'Android debug APK'
scripts.mobile:aab: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd .. && npm run play:validate && node scripts/release-record.mjs --artifact android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab --label 'Android release bundle'
scripts.mobile:ipa: npm run mobile:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportPath build/export -exportOptionsPlist ../ExportOptions.plist && cd ../.. && node scripts/release-record.mjs --artifact 'ios/App/build/export/*.ipa' --label 'iOS archive'
